reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing read-only search, inspection, comparison, and reporting tools for GitHub and other developer ecosystems through external APIs, with caching and optional GitHub authentication.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨 GitHub 及多个开发者生态的只读搜索、仓库分析、版本与社区数据查询工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with read-only search, repository analysis, release, and community data tools across GitHub and multiple developer ecosystems.

capabilities: read-only queries to external developer platforms and registries
repository, package, issue, release, contributor, trend, and ecosystem search
optional use of a GitHub token for higher rate limits
